rules: This reservation and the exact V39 coordinate must be committed before dev-v35 membership is created or read.
Membership construction and disjointness verification are primary-agent-only and must not render seed values into agent output.
The committed one-way consumer must atomically create the dev-v35 umbrella attempt before its first manifest read or baseline episode.
A started, aborted, failed, exposed, or completed dev-v35 attempt consumes that set permanently.
No dev-v35 access is authorized until exact replicas and reusable permanent-greedy and matched-greedy scorecards pass.
Held-out-v5 remains governed by its existing V38 freeze and cannot be read until dev-v35 passes every frozen gate.
